m13.text: Nira is a nacatl Sunstriker who, in Magic 2013, introduces herself to Lia and explains that a demon is harvesting bones for a ritual, killing countless creatures just to give himself more power. She tells Lia that the demon has taken her village and family to the ruins, and that Lia is a stonekiller whom she needs to destroy the dragon skeleton's keystone.

Nira gives Lia the warrior name Kaa-lia, and the two watch from a ridge as black-clad servants gather in the arena. They sneak in and begin climbing a rib as the ritual shakes the ground, but a bald man reaches the walkway and fights Nira, nearly knocking her off.

The bald man throws Kaalia off the walkway and Nira leaps after her, twisting her body to cushion the fall as the spine snaps and the skeleton falls, killing the man. Nira tells Kaalia to flee, saying the rest of the Sunstrikers are lost, and Kaalia awakes to devastation and vows to kill the demon.
